1.title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
1.summary: The fire has burned around 10,500 acres and is completely uncontained, officials say.

2.title: Sean Grayson, Ex-Illinois Deputy Who Murdered Sonya Massey, Dies in Prison
2.summary: Sean Grayson, 32, was serving a 20-year sentence for the 2024 murder of Sonya Massey, who was holding a pot of hot water when she was shot at her home.

3.title: In West Texas, Trump’s Border Wall Collides With Latino History
3.summary: A century ago, Mexican American families came together to build an adobe church near the border. Can its bell toll again as the wall expansion nears?

4.title: Syria and Israel Hold U.S.-Mediated Talks to Try to Ease Tensions
4.summary: The discussions, reported by the Syrian state news agency, came days after Israel struck an air base in Syria’s northwest, the latest in a series of military interventions.

5.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham Arrives in Ukraine as Russia Amps Up Warnings
5.summary: In his first foreign trip since taking office, Prime Minister Andy Burnham affirmed support for Kyiv despite new warnings from Moscow of potential consequences.

6.title: Can ‘Argentina’s Texas’ Save the Country’s Economy?
6.summary: Thousands of Argentines are flocking to a remote stretch of Patagonia, seeking work with only backpacks, tents and the hope that they and their country can turn around their fortunes.
